findings.where: right-panel step glosses and left-panel muted text
findings.evidence: Confirms sweep A11-001 by eye on tile 1920-00: grey-brown italic glosses ('Midjourney / DALL·E / SDXL', '没风格、没受众、没视角', 'Pentagram / Takram / Build') at 13px sit at about 2.6:1 on #0a0a0a; on a projector with ambient light these disappear. They carry content (what the generic agent skipped), not decoration.
findings.after: Raise to at least #a39a8a (about 7:1) and 20px+ on a 1920 canvas, or cut the glosses
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.4.3 Contrast (Minimum); slides need a higher margin than screens.

findings.evidence: dom-1920.json: alt texts are 'Pentagram · DeepSeek V4', 'Takram · DeepSeek V4', 'Build · DeepSeek V4'. They name the school but not what each cover shows, and the thumbnails' own text ('几乎贴近前沿，价格只是零头。', '深度求索 V4 在百万 token 中思考。') is unreadable at 320px and absent from the alt.
findings.after: alt="Takram direction: warm paper cover, headline '深度求索 V4 在百万 token 中思考', triangle diagram, quiet serif"
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 1.1.1 Non-text Content: the images are the evidence of the slide and their alt must carry it.

findings.evidence: Confirms sweep: steps fade in with class 'show' (42% of text hidden until the sequence runs) and the stylesheet has no prefers-reduced-motion rule; the only control is a REPLAY button.
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 2.3.3 Animation from Interactions (AAA) and 2.2.2 for auto-starting sequences; content must exist without the animation.

findings.evidence: html lang="zh" but large English runs ('A real task from yesterday', 'IN PRACTICE', 'huashu-design', 'SWISS · GRID') are not marked lang="en"; a Chinese voice will mispronounce them. No headings or landmarks: the slide headline is a div.
findings.after: A real task from yesterday; make the headline an
findings.why: WCAG 2.2 3.1.2 Language of Parts and 1.3.1 Info and Relationships.

strengths: Headline and panel titles are large serif at high contrast (white/gold on near-black).
The only control, '↻ REPLAY', is a real button with a name and visible focus.
